semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in reliability testing equipment for power devices, which is critical in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Headspring provides advanced test equipment for the reliability evaluation of power devices, including IGBTs and SiC modules. Their offerings comply with various industry standards and include support services for testing FPGAs, DSPs, and VLSIs, facilitating comprehensive evaluation processes.
capabilities: Reliability test equipment for MOSFETs and IGBTs compatible with AQG324 and AEC-Q101 standards
Dynamic high-temperature and high-humidity testing systems
Evaluation equipment for FPGAs, DSPs, and VLSIs
Test implementation support services from consultation to result analysis
